import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 10;
    static final int MAX_M = 25;
    static final int MAX_S = 1048580;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int n;
    static int[][] prob = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] match_avail = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[] powers_of_two = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] row_a = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] row_b = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] dp_f = new int[MAX_S];
    static int[] dp_g = new int[MAX_S];
    static int total_states;
    static int[] state_id = new int[70];
    static int[][] points = new int[MAX_M][MAX_N];
    static int[] state_stack = new int[MAX_M];
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAX_N];

    static int mod_pow(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (int) ((long) result * base % MOD);
            base = (int) ((long) base * base % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void initialize() {
        powers_of_two[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; ++i) powers_of_two[i] = powers_of_two[i-1] * 2;
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        int inv_100 = mod_pow(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                prob[i][j] = scanner.nextInt();
                prob[i][j] = (int) ((long) prob[i][j] * inv_100 % MOD);
            }
        while (n < 6) {
            ++n;
            prob[n][n] = 1;
        }
    }

    static boolean try_match(int depth) {
        if (depth > 3) return true;
        for (int candidate = 1; candidate <= 3; ++candidate) {
            if (!visited[candidate] && match_avail[row_a[depth]][row_b[candidate]] == 1) {
                visited[candidate] = true;
                if (try_match(depth + 1)) {
                    visited[candidate] = false;
                    return true;
                }
                visited[candidate] = false;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void dfs_second(int row, int col, int current_prob) {
        if (row > 3) {
            int bitmask = 0;
            for (int idx = 1; idx <= total_states; ++idx) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= 3; ++k) row_b[k] = points[idx][k];
                if (try_match(1)) bitmask |= powers_of_two[idx - 1];
            }
            dp_f[bitmask] = (dp_f[bitmask] + current_prob) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        match_avail[row_a[row]][col] = 0;
        if (col == n) dfs_second(row + 1, 1, (int) ((long) current_prob * (1 - prob[row_a[row]][col] + MOD) % MOD));
        else dfs_second(row, col + 1, (int) ((long) current_prob * (1 - prob[row_a[row]][col] + MOD) % MOD));
        match_avail[row_a[row]][col] = 1;
        if (col == n) dfs_second(row + 1, 1, (int) ((long) current_prob * prob[row_a[row]][col] % MOD));
        else dfs_second(row, col + 1, (int) ((long) current_prob * prob[row_a[row]][col] % MOD));
    }

    static void dfs_first(int idx, int count, int mask) {
        if (count == 3) {
            state_id[mask] = ++total_states;
            state_stack[total_states] = mask;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) points[total_states][i] = row_a[i];
            return;
        }
        if (idx > n) return;
        dfs_first(idx + 1, count, mask);
        row_a[count + 1] = idx;
        dfs_first(idx + 1, count + 1, mask | powers_of_two[idx - 1]);
    }

    static void precompute_g() {
        for (int i = 0; i < total_states; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << total_states); ++j)
                if ((j & (1 << i)) != 0) dp_g[j] = (dp_g[j] + dp_g[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        initialize();
        dfs_first(1, 0, 0);
        row_a[1] = 1; row_a[2] = 2; row_a[3] = 3;
        dfs_second(1, 1, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << total_states); ++i) {
            int transformed = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= total_states; ++j) {
                int complement_id = state_id[(1 << n) - 1 - state_stack[j]];
                if ((i & (1 << (j - 1))) != 0) transformed |= (1 << (complement_id - 1));
            }
            dp_g[transformed] = dp_f[i];
            dp_f[i] = 0;
        }
        row_a[1] = 4; row_a[2] = 5; row_a[3] = 6;
        dfs_second(1, 1, 1);
        precompute_g();
        int answer = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << total_states); ++i)
            answer = (answer + (int) ((long) dp_f[i] * dp_g[(1 << total_states) - 1 - i] % MOD)) % MOD;
        System.out.println((1 - answer + MOD) % MOD);
    }
}
